notes.title: The Soundtrack is Rolling Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello all!  

The Poco Original Soundtrack is officially publishing on all streaming services, starting today.

It may take a few days for it to appear on some services, but you can find it right now on [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/3adjcyDlPxYCiAQ6PwkqED"]Spotify[/url], [url="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSb659fJBj5ZEDo02yED9hrR06SKQbSNX&si=22QP7SlkvxF9dgr-"]YouTube[/url], and right here on Steam as a DLC![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience. It's been a long, slow process.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p]Micah[/p]

notes.title: Ko-fi open now, soundtrack coming soon
notes.content:
Hello all!

Thanks for a great first week of Poco! The team and I have really appreciated all the engagement, it's been really exciting to see our little game spread so much joy.

We just wanted to announce that we've opened a [url=https://ko-fi.com/whalefallgames]Whalefall Ko-fi[/url] for those of you who would be interested in supporting our small team in future endeavors. We truly appreciate any amount you are willing to give.

In addition, we've seen all the comments and reviews in search of a soundtrack, and we wanted to you let you know that it's on its way. Soon, the soundtrack will be coming to streaming services everywhere, so stay tuned!

Thanks again for all the support,
Micah

notes.title: Release + A Little Patch
notes.content:
Hello Poco People!

Thank you so much for playing the game! The last 3 days since release have been a wild ride, and the team and I have really enjoyed seeing your reactions and reading all your kind words. We're so glad to see that people are appreciating our little game around the world.

I also noticed a few little bugs and glitches, so I just put up a patch to fix a few things. The biggest/most noticeable change would be that the dreaded rhythm game is a bit easier now, as the cracks heal in the button after a string of consecutive successful notes. I've also slowed the fishing minigame a bit. Hopefully these changes ease some of the frustration we've been noticing around.

Thanks again for playing!
Micah

notes.title: Poco is Funded!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Great news! The Poco Kickstarter has officially been funded!

If you're still interested in backing us, there's still time, and any additional funds beyond our goal would still be a big help going forward.

So visit our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thatpocogame/poco-a-2d-3d-hybrid-point-and-click-adventure-game?ref=profile_created&category_id=35]Kickstarter[/url] if you haven't already, and have a look at our backer rewards.

Thank you so much for all your support!
Micah
